_comment: The libgit2 wrap campaign's wavefront configuration, the only one: every query of the bindings and reviews resolves through it, and it orders and schedules the modules. Paths are below the C root, c/, wavefront's repo_root.

closure: the files of every module of crustify/artifacts/modules.json, impl_files its translation units and internal headers, api_headers the installed headers libgit2.so publishes. The TUs the configured build compiles empty (src/libgit2/streams/openssl_dynamic.c, openssl_legacy.c, schannel.c, stransport.c, src/libgit2/transports/auth_gssapi.c, auth_sspi.c, ssh_exec.c, winhttp.c) are configured out, as are the deprecated shims deprecated.h, cred_helpers.h and sys/cred.h and the MSVC-only stdint.h.

modules: one record per module of modules.json, named <link-unit>/<name>, with ' (foundational)' after a foundational module's name; its files are the module's file entries with their items, as {name, kind}, each item an entity its file is home to (a typedef follows the tag it names, so a shared header's typedef of a struct another file defines is claimed there). Macros are listed by none.

schedule_seeds: the files of the modules planner run 3 plans, every module of the campaign, so that the out-of-scope entities no module owns (deprecated items, and declarations the configured build never defines, which modules.json's file entries exclude) are not seeded.
